newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks close up 6.33 pct on foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks close up 6.33 pct on foreign buying.

text.p: Foreigners continued to buy large capitalised Thai stocks on Friday following de facto devaluation of the baht announced earlier this week, pushing the stocks to close 6.33 percent higher, brokers said.
The composite SET index advanced 39.11 points to finish at 657.09 on 16.5 billion baht turnover. The SET-50 index rose 3.43 points to 49.16.

"There was some selling of blue-chip stocks such as Thai Military Bank, Siam Cement, PTT Exploration and Production and Krung Thai Bank for profit-taking earlier in the day," said Thanadech Mahapokai of Book Club Finance and Securities.
The SET index, which hit an intraday high 11 minutes after the opening of 668.17 retreated because of the selling.
"However, the index managed to rise in the afternoon as foreigners bought some communication, bank, finance and property issues," said Thanadech.
